title: Building Field Configuration
description: Restricts which zone types and selection/placement strategies this building's search_rules and putaway_rules are allowed to use.

allowed_zone_types.description: Which Topology-as-Code entity kinds a search_rule.steps[].zone may reference.

allowed_selection_strategies.description: Subset of elements/selection_strategies.yaml ids usable in this building's search_rules.

allowed_placement_strategies.description: Subset of elements/placement_strategies.yaml ids usable in this building's putaway_rules. Optional: a building without putaway_rules does not need it.
